title: Severe flooding reported in Koramangala after heavy rainfall
text: Multiple streets in Koramangala 4th and 5th Block are waterlogged after continuous rainfall for 6 hours. Water level rising rapidly. Several cars stranded.

title: Flooding getting worse in Koramangala - water entering houses
text: Water has started entering ground floor apartments in Koramangala 5th Block. Residents stuck on upper floors. Need rescue boats.

title: Koramangala flood: Storm water drain overflows
text: The main storm water drain near Sony World junction has overflowed. Traffic completely halted. BBMP teams on site.

title: Fire in HSR Layout industrial warehouse
text: Large fire visible at warehouse near HSR Layout 27th Main. Thick black smoke. Fire trucks have not arrived yet.

title: Fire spreading to adjacent buildings in HSR
text: The warehouse fire in HSR is spreading. Two adjacent buildings now on fire. Residents evacuating. One injury reported.

title: Major road accident on Outer Ring Road near Marathahalli
text: Multi-vehicle pileup on ORR near Marathahalli bridge. At least 5 vehicles involved. Several people injured. Traffic backed up for 3km.

title: Power outage across BTM Layout
text: Complete power failure in BTM Layout 1st and 2nd stage since 2 hours. Hospitals running on generators. Traffic signals not working.

title: Power still out in BTM - getting dangerous at night
text: BTM Layout still has no power. Streets completely dark. Two minor accidents reported due to non-functional traffic signals.

title: Building collapse in Majestic area
text: A three-story residential building has partially collapsed near Majestic bus stand. Rescue operations underway. People feared trapped under rubble.

title: Gas leak reported in Electronic City
text: Strong chemical smell near industrial area in Electronic City Phase 1. Workers complaining of dizziness. Factory evacuated.

title: Flooding continues - rescue boats deployed in Koramangala
text: NDRF teams deployed with rescue boats in Koramangala. Over 100 families evacuated so far. Water level still rising.

title: Accident on ORR - ambulances can't reach due to traffic jam
text: The pileup on ORR has caused a massive jam. Ambulances stuck. Injured people waiting for help. Someone please clear the road.
